title: The Blocked Door
setup: Both sides have a runner, and the black king is standing one file outside the white pawn's box.
hint: Count the h-pawn's box, then look at which of its entry squares one of your own pieces is sitting on.
explanation:
## The Idea

The box is h5–h8–e8–e5, and Black's own pawn occupies e5, the natural door. {{Ke6}} is the only other way in, and from there the king shadows the pawn to h8. Racing with {{e4}} loses by a single move. Count your own pieces before you count White's.
